messages:
sam: Heads-up — seeing a new eviction pattern in eu-west1 this morning. Lots of tiny single-GPU pods getting bounced while reserved multi-GPU gangs sit idle. Feels like a 'ghost taint' where taint/affinity heuristics treat warm nodes as unavailable. Anyone else?

maya: yup, noticed a fragmentation spike around 04:12 UTC. Pending queue of small pods up x4. Warm-pool drain churn looks suspicious.

devon: digging into scheduler logs now — we see nodes with transient taints stamped by node-prober after brief NIC flaps. The scoring function then applies a big penalty and won’t pack fractional pods onto those racks.

lina: can confirm repro in staging with a small churn sim. The taint decay TTL is generous (10m) so once a node gets marked it stays unattractive for a long time; combined with strict anti-affinity, we create micro-islands.

sam: propose quick canary: reduce taint penalty multiplier and shorten decay (10m -> 2m), and allow soft-fractional packing on taintged nodes for tiny-pod class. Low-risk config flip.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout of scheduler-config v1.41-canary to eu-west1 (target 5% of schedulers). Watch /monitoring/scheduler/pack_score.

devon: after canary flip — tiny-pod pending dropped ~30% within 6m on canary hosts. Be aware though: tail latency for heavy infer jobs on those hosts rose ~15%.

maya: noted. Cost tradeoff: better consolidation reduces GPU-hours but increases co-tenancy risk; keep an eye on p95 latency and OOMs.

lina: long-term idea: epoch-based taint decay + a lighter-weight 'taint history' feature that gradually fades penalty instead of binary block. Also snapshot binpack occupancy per rack so scoring can prefer partially filled NVLink islands.

devon: opened ENG-7128 with perf numbers, logs, and a couple of flamegraphs. Attaching canary diff and the simple benchmark script I used.

sam: nice. For immediate ops: add an alert for pending tiny-pod ratio > 0.2 for 10m and an automated job that kicks a compacting pass (descheduler/compact) once the ratio holds.

maya: already added a short-term dashboard tile (pack density, pending tiny pods, taint-count) and a cost widget for GPU-hours delta.

ops-bot: ci-bot: canary rollout completed to 5% schedulers, no crashloop; monitoring looking stable for 12m.

devon: leaving the canary up for 30m, will snapshot logs and rollback if heavy-infer p95 > 2x baseline.

lina: leftover follow-ups: (1) try fractional gang packing in a subset of racks, (2) prototype taint-decay smoothing, (3) tune warm-pool drain thresholds.

sam: agreed. If this recurs after config and descheduler runs, escalate to a mitigation playbook (evict big idle gangs to defrag) — but only after we measure impact on SLAs.

maya: thanks folks. tagging @devon to follow-through on ENG-7128 and @lina on the taint-decay spike design. :thumbsup:

devon: ack, will post updates in ENG-7128 and link results here.

sam: closing thread for now; will re-open if metrics breakeven doesn't hold by EOD.
